name: Ramen Noodles with Boiled Egg
assumptions: Yield estimated from single egg and single packet of noodles as primary components; instructions appear written for 1 serving.

Preparation minutes is a conservative estimate covering boiling (7 min), ice bath (5 min), optional quick marinate reference (ignored for min time), noodle cooking (~5 min), and assembly; full marination would be 4+ hours but is labeled optional.
Mirin and sugar mentioned in instructions but absent from listed ingredients, treated as unlisted/optional and not affecting classifications.
Chilli sauce treated as ambiguous for allergens (could contain wheat/soy/sesame/fish in some varieties) and diets.
Spring onions, salt, pepper, and water are neutral to all diets and allergens.
Noodles assumed to be standard wheat-based ramen (hence wheat and gluten).
Soy sauce confirms soy and likely wheat presence.
instructions:
Boil: Bring water to a boil, gently add eggs, and cook for exactly 6½ to 7 minutes.
Ice Bath: Immediately transfer the eggs to a bowl of ice water for 3–5 minutes to stop cooking.
Marinate (Optional but recommended): Peel the eggs and marinate in a mix of 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tsp sugar, and 4 tbsp water for at least 4 hours (or overnight).
Serve: Slice in half, letting the yolk flow into the broth

ingredients.name: Noodles
ingredients.assumptions: Standard single-serve instant ramen noodle packet, dry weight ~85g; typical for a quick Chinese-style ramen dish.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.assumptions: 2 cups water used for boiling noodles and/or broth base; water contributes zero macros.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large egg (~50g edible portion); boiled as per instructions, using whole egg with yolk.

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp soy sauce (~15g); used in marinate or as seasoning, typical sodium-rich Chinese variety.

ingredients.name: Chilli Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp chilli sauce (~3g); small amount for heat, assuming typical Asian chilli/garlic sauce with minor carbs.

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbls chopped spring onions (~10g); used as garnish, typical green onion values.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tsp table salt (~3g); pure sodium chloride, zero caloric contribution.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.assumptions: 1/2 tbs ground black pepper (~2-3g); negligible macros, used for seasoning.
